rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for “anywhere” or “wherever you like.”

example.english: You can go wherever you want.
example.jyutping: nei5 soeng2 heoi3 bin1 dou6 dou1 dak1

rows.jyutping: mou4 leon6 hai2 bin1 dou6 dou1 V
rows.note: Use this when you want to make the “no matter where” meaning explicit for a place or situation.

example.english: Wherever you are, wear a mask.
example.jyutping: mou4 leon6 hai2 bin1 dou6 dou1 daai3 hau2 zaau3

rows.jyutping: bin1 dou6 seoi1 jiu3 zau6 V
rows.note: Use this for “wherever it is needed,” with the action applying in each place that needs it.

example.english: We’ll send it wherever it’s needed.
example.jyutping: bin1 dou6 seoi1 jiu3 zau6 sung3 heoi3 bin1 dou6

rows.note: Use this as an aside when you do not know where the mentioned person or thing is located.

example.english: I don’t know where he is, wherever he may be.
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 zi1 keoi5 hai2 bin1 dou6
